notes: Table 2 has five candidate effects under printed header β (SE): Panel A DTM → F direct effect 0.08 (SE 0.17; CI −0.25, 0.41), DTM → MR → F 0.45 (SE 0.13; CI 0.16, 0.69); Panel B DTM → EMP → F −0.01 (SE 0.04; CI −0.12, 0.07), DTM → MR → EMP → F 0.03 (SE 0.04; CI −0.02, 0.19), DTM → MR → F 0.44 (SE 0.12; CI 0.17, 0.65). No candidate selected: description does not identify a path or panel, and describes relationship closeness, which was excluded from Study 1. Header β alone is not independent documentation of standardization. No effect-size conversion performed. Table 2 reports bootstrap 95% CIs and bold significance, no exact p or numerical p bound. The independent-regression p values on p. 20 belong to different tests and were not borrowed. Candidate recruitment N=55 is not verified as critical-model analytic N; no N derived from df and no group sum performed. PDF p. 6 rendered and inspected. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
